A medium-sized battery used primarily on aircraft and medium-sized ships. Battery holds 3200 units of power.

For in-game mechanics, see [Electricity](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Game_Mechanics/Electricity)

Medium Batteries are unlocked via the [Electrics](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Electrics_Research) research.
